title: A quiet lead isn’t a lost lead.
desc: A considered follow-up brings the conversation back. When a lead replies, the next step follows their intent.
messages: Hi Aarav, you asked about our office spaces last week. Are you still looking in Gurugram?
Yes, but we need something for 12 people.
Of course. Would you prefer a ready-to-move office or a customised space?
Ready to move. Can we visit tomorrow?
I’ll connect you with our team to arrange your visit.

title: Answers that move a deal forward.
desc: Use your business knowledge to answer questions, understand requirements, and bring your team in at the right moment.
messages: Hi Rohan, I can help with your packaging machine enquiry. What would you like to know?
Is installation included? We need it in Pune.
The industrial packaging unit. Please call after 3 pm.
Thanks. I’ll connect you with our specialist to confirm installation and a quote for Pune.

title: The right follow-up. At the right time.
desc: Give every interested enquiry a clear next step, without relying on someone remembering to follow up.
messages: Hi Priya, would you like help choosing the right course for your team?
Thanks! What would you like your team to be able to do after the training?
That helps. I’ll pass the requirement to our advisor for a tailored session.
